CALIFORNIA PRELIMINARY NOTICE

TO THE OWNER: Harborview Ridge Investors LLC, 2400 Broadway, Suite 500, Oakland, California 94612

TO THE DIRECT CONTRACTOR: Cordova Builders, Inc., 1155 Marina Village Parkway, Alameda, California 94501

TO THE CONSTRUCTION LENDER: Peninsula Trust Bank, Construction Loan Administration, 300 Lakeside Drive, 18th Floor, Oakland, California 94612

FROM THE CLAIMANT: Alder Mechanical Systems, Inc., California Contractor License No. 1024118, 830 Aileen Street, Oakland, California 94608, (510) 555-0126

1. Description of the Project.

The work of improvement is located at 4711 Telegraph Avenue, Oakland, California 94609, further described as Alameda County Assessor's Parcel No. 013-1082-024-00, and known as the Harborview Ridge mixed-use project.

2. Description of the Labor, Services, Equipment, or Materials Furnished.

The Claimant has furnished, or will furnish, labor, services, equipment, and materials consisting of the design, fabrication, and installation of the heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, and plumbing systems for the project.

3. Name of the Person Who Contracted for the Work.

The Claimant furnishes the above at the request of, and under a subcontract with, Cordova Builders, Inc., the direct contractor.

4. Estimated Total Price.

The estimated price of the labor, services, equipment, and materials described above is $1,486,000.

NOTICE TO PROPERTY OWNER

If bills are not paid in full for the labor, services, equipment, or materials furnished or to be furnished, a mechanics lien leading to the loss, through court foreclosure proceedings, of all or part of your property being so improved may be placed against the property even though you have paid your direct contractor in full. You may wish to protect yourself against this consequence by (1) requiring your contractor to furnish a signed release by the person or firm giving you this notice before making payment to your contractor, or (2) any other method that is appropriate under the circumstances. This notice is required by law to be served by the undersigned as a statement of your legal rights. This notice is not intended to reflect upon the financial condition of the contractor or the person employed by you on the construction project. If you record a notice of cessation or completion of your construction project, you must within 10 days after recording send a copy of the notice to your contractor and to any person who has given you this notice. The notice must be sent by registered or certified mail. Failure to send the notice shortens the period during which a mechanics lien may be recorded and shall extend the deadline to record the lien to 90 days after the completion of the work of improvement.

5. Proof of Service by Mail.

I, Marisol Trevino, declare that I served copies of this Preliminary Notice by first-class certified mail, postage prepaid, with a certificate of mailing, addressed to each of the persons named above at the addresses stated above, on August 24, 2026, by depositing the same in the United States mail at Oakland, California. I declare under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing is true and correct.
